recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11285 unless a future work group decision reintroduces explicit ImagingStudy procedure coding guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-11285 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for the DSTU2 ImagingStudy ballot comment. It asked to remove the ImagingStudy.procedure comment recommending LOINC radiology orderables because ImagingStudy can be used outside radiology and implementers should choose the right value set for their environment.
initial_application: Commit b838ed23f345f4271d38d8146ca240d4a4ef1a89, "Updates to ImagingStudy for CP GF#10740, GF#11282, and GF#11285", removed the old "For the Procedure.code, LOINC radiology orderables would be a good value set to use" comment from the ImagingStudy spreadsheet source. The old comment had been introduced by FHIR-6243 in commit d2e4d8176dcfeb1e57198c63a8a0270acb6c5a88.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Current source has ImagingStudy.procedure as Reference(Procedure) with only a comment about using ImagingStudy.encounter for Encounter linkage; radiology, LOINC orderables, RadLex, and RSNA guidance are not present. Later radiology-playbook Zulip discussion concerned value set URI availability and did not conflict with the removal decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope ImagingStudy source already reflects FHIR-11285 by omitting the radiology-specific Procedure.code recommendation.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-6243 originally introduced the LOINC radiology orderables comment that FHIR-11285 later removed.
